message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; the code reads pickle/json files and uses them directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local pickle/zip files with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote source handling.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only counts label distribution with Counter for imbalance checking, but does not validate labels against an expected set or detect label-flipping anomalies.

No detected model integrity verification: The code initializes a new model from scratch (PointNetClassification) and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification is performed or needed.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no multiple independent metrics explicitly logged, and the test set isolation relies solely on sklearn's train_test_split without any additional integrity guarantees.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads pickled data and passes it directly to the model via DataLoader without any shape, range, or schema validation on the incoming inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) visible in the inference path; test_net is called without any post-prediction sanity checks in the shown code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a 3D point cloud classification model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
